overview_description.description:
Lovage is a platform that helps barbers and stylists turn open appointment slots into booked clients.

Beauty professionals frequently have gaps in their schedules due to cancellations, no-shows, and uneven demand. These empty slots represent lost revenue and underutilized capacity.

Lovage solves this by converting open availability into demand. By integrating with booking systems, Lovage detects available time slots and helps professionals instantly share that availability as bookable content across channels like Instagram.

The result is more bookings, higher utilization, and increased revenue—without relying on ads or manual marketing.

Lovage is building the demand generation layer for service-based businesses, starting with barbers and stylists.
